answer_4.quote: We conducted a human evaluation. We randomly sampled 370 claim-article pairs whose articles were with over 20 sentences from the Weibo dataset. Then we showed each claim and top three sentences selected from the corresponding FC-article by MTM. Three annotators were asked to check if an auto-selected sentence helped match the given query and the source article (i.e., key sentences).
